# Third-party crates

Third-party crates patched for kb through `[patch.crates-io]` in the workspace `Cargo.toml`. Each is the published
release with the smallest change that fixes it; drop it as soon as an upstream release does.

| Crate                  | Why                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Change                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Drop when                                                                      |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `block 0.1.6`          | Reached only through GPUI Kit 0.7.1's macOS layers (`cocoa`, `core-graphics2`, `core-video`). It declares `static _NSConcreteStackBlock: Class` with `enum Class {}`, a static of an uninhabited type, which every build reports as code a future Rust rejects (rust-lang/rust#74840). Unmaintained since 2016. | `src/lib.rs`: `Class` becomes `#[repr(C)] struct Class { _private: [u8; 0] }`, an opaque inhabited type; the static is only ever taken by address. `Cargo.toml`: `[lints.rust] missing_abi = "allow"`, for its 46 `extern fn` without an explicit `"C"`. | GPUI Kit no longer depends on `block` (its `objc2` / `block2` migration). MIT. |
| `gpui-pre-macos 0.3.8` | GPUI resizes a window by `setContentSize`, which keeps its bottom-left corner, and has no API to move a window: kb's ⌘⇧F size toggle (DESIGN.md, Layout) would push the panel off the screen's centre.                                                                                                          | `src/window.rs` `resize`: sets the frame around the old frame's centre (`setFrame:display:`) instead of the content size. kb's panel has no title bar, so frame and content sizes match.                                                                 | GPUI can position or centre a window. Apache-2.0.                              |
